annotations.title: Check whether a product was recalled (France and EU)

description: Checks whether a product was recalled in France (RappelConso) or the EU (Safety Gate, since 2022) by its barcode number (GTIN/EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8). recalled true lists each recall with its date, reason, risks, measures and the lots concerned (all_lots false means only those lots); compare the lots with the product at hand. recalled false comes with checked_at and each source's freshness. If a source's backfilled is false, its older recalls may still be missing.

gtin.description: Barcode number, 8 to 14 digits; spaces allowed
